description: Pavement Condition Index is a dataset listed in City of Richmond open data portal (www.transparentrichmond.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Richmond. Overall average condition of roadways, measured annually. Coverage: Richmond, Virginia. The portal files it under the category Engineering & Capital Improvement Projects. Its tags are pavement, pavement condition, streets. The table has 2 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Richmond Engineering. The portal shows 2019-09-23 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-transparentrichmond-org-portal.
